Scaly.Settings.Category.Description: Where Visual Studio finds the Scaly programs.
Scaly.Settings.ServerPath.Description: Path to scalyls.exe. Empty: scalyls on PATH, then the scaly.io installation (%USERPROFILE%\.scaly\toolchain\libexec). Takes effect when the server starts next.
Scaly.Settings.ToolPath.Description: Path to scaly.exe, used to build and debug a .scaly file. Empty: scaly on PATH, then the scaly.io installation.
Scaly.Settings.Home.Description: The prelude and package root handed to the language server and the build. Empty: the open folder when it is a Scaly checkout (holds packages/scaly), else what the installed programs set themselves.
Scaly.Settings.Target.Description: The target triple Build, F5 and Ctrl+F5 build for, handed to scaly build as --target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc builds an x64 program on an Arm PC, which Windows runs under emulation. Empty: the machine's own.
